orderId.description: The order number, for example SO-10023. Use get_order_status first if the line number is unknown.

lineNumber.description: The order line to return, numbered 1, 2, 3 as listed by get_order_status.

quantity.description: How many items of that line to return. At least 1 and not more than ordered.

reason.description: Return reason: Damaged, WrongItem, NotAsDescribed or NoLongerNeeded.

comment.description: Optional note from the customer, for example what is damaged. Leave it empty if there is none.
